items.title: Physical-device Android and iOS acceptance
items.reason: Emulator/simulator evidence does not certify physical keyboard, camera, storage, biometric, power or OEM lifecycle behaviour.

items.title: Interactive iOS simulator acceptance
items.reason: Windows cannot host an interactive iOS simulator; macOS simulator build and shared UI contracts are the software gate.

items.title: Observed school-user longitudinal usability study
items.reason: Synthetic personas and records validate software flow, not real-user training, policy adoption or production data use.

items.title: Large-grid virtualization only where measured
items.reason: Add virtualization only if synthetic or staging measurements exceed the accepted interaction budget; preserve keyboard and screen-reader semantics.

items.title: Staff biometric mapping activation
items.reason: Product Experience includes only a privacy-safe placeholder; no biometric template, device secret or ingestion flow is present.
